notes.message: `state/irrelevant-field` names a field at a time, and this state has none to name.
The checks that compare questions need two to compare. This run carried 1, so they did not run.

cleared.advice_caveat: Read this one before acting on it. The rewrite it asks for is measured on one question; how often it points at a query that is already fine is not.

findings.title: Question depends on another question's answer
findings.message: This question is written to use something another question in the same request produces.
findings.hint: Questions in one request are independent, so what this names is not there to be read and the question is answered as though the material were absent. Measured on decision-v7's contrastive rows: with the policy the question needs moved out of the state and into another question's instructions, the label is answered 20 of 30 against 27 of 30 with it in the state, at a Brier score of 0.237 against 0.064. Deleting the policy outright reads 20 of 30 and 0.242, so a sibling carries nothing. Accept it where the phrase points at the material rather than at an answer the request has to produce.
findings.suggest: Put what the question needs into the state. Where the second question cannot be built until the first is answered, send it as a second request.
findings.evidence: Read: "Which option is the correct answer to the question above?"

findings.title: Choice has no fallback option
findings.message: None of the options is an `other` or `none of the above`.
findings.hint: Without a catch-all the probability mass has nowhere to go, so it lands on the nearest wrong label. Measured on decision-v7: where the answer was none of the options, removing the catch-all put a mean 0.79 on a label that could not be right and cost a Brier score of 0.660 against 0.349 with it. Where the answer was among the options it cost nothing.
findings.suggest: Add `"other": "Anything the other options do not cover"`.

value.other: Anything the other options do not cover

findings.title: A Choice over an outcome the material does not settle
findings.message: The options name an outcome the material does not settle, so the probability beside the answer is not a likelihood.
findings.hint: A Choice reports a probability for the option it picks, and over an outcome the material cannot settle that number is not a likelihood. Measured outside this repository, by jev-does-not-play-dice: on a hidden fair die roll a mean 0.83 on the picked face against a chance of 0.17, with accuracy at 19.0% over 400 calls, and on a coin 0.92 at 52.0% accuracy. The same die asked as a Noul read 0.19, so what the number is worth follows from the primitive and not from the question. The trigger is 0.70 because over the four draws that project recorded and two outcomes written here this reads 0.83 and up, while over fourteen Choice questions whose material does settle them it reads 0.53 and down. The reading nearest the line is a question about what somebody wants, which the material leaves unstated, so a finding on one of those is the one to read rather than act on. Accept it where you read the label and never the number beside it.
findings.suggest: Where you act on the probability, take the question out: no primitive reports a likelihood for an outcome the material does not settle. Where you act on the label alone, keep the question and leave the number unread.
findings.evidence: Read: "Which option is the correct answer to the question above?" with {"A":"Introversion","B":"Neuroticism","C":"Rigidity","D":"Mid-life crisis"}

findings.title: The question is built on a record the state does not hold
findings.message: The question is built on a record this state does not carry.
findings.hint: A question built on a record the state never carries still comes back with a probability. Check this against the states you send, not a tidy example. Accept it where the state legitimately varies and the caller already gates on another question that says whether the record is there.
findings.suggest: Send the record your question turns on - the thing it asks about - so the state carries what the question needs. Where a state legitimately does not have it, skip the question for that state instead of asking it anyway: an answer to a question the material cannot settle is a number with nothing behind it.
